dct_description_sm: Abstract: The street edge transportation coverage is a polyline layer describing the driveable surface of streets within the Town of Brookline, Massachusetts. A related transportation feature (Back Edge of Sidewalks) is in a separate coverage. This data layer is from Boston Edison Company (BECo.). The street edge data layer was originally based on aerial photographs from 1990 and 1991 at 1" = 600' negative scale. Digital planmetric data meet National Map Accuracy Standards for 1"=100' (1:1200) mapping.

Purpose: This dataset was developed to depict the "edge-of-pavement", or driveable surface, of all streets within the Town of Brookline. These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. More advanced user applications may focus on transportation management functions (e.g. maintenance of road networks), routing applications as well as in plots where inclusion of road networks are deemed appropriate. Other user applications may focus on planning, public works, or utilities purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output).
